title: Affine sections for chosen normalized diagonal conormal derivation
statement: For every f, U, V and hUV, the canonical normalized derivation chosen by exists_diagonalConormalDerivation admits an A-linear Kaehler differential equivalence with the asserted d-formula.

proof.text: Choose D from exists_diagonalConormalDerivation and obtain its normalization by Classical.choose_spec. On sections of U construct a ring derivation relative to f.appLE using ModuleCat.Derivation.mk: the additivity and Leibniz rules are inherited from D, and the base-ring vanishing follows from appLE_eq_pullbackPresheafToPresheaf_app and Derivation'.d_app. Its universal Kähler lift e = d.desc.hom is a real linear map, and ModuleCat.Derivation.desc_d proves e(da)=D(a).
Apply the affine lift injectivity theorem to this e and its d-formula.

The derivation-span theorem says the values D(a) span conormal sections. Each value belongs to LinearMap.range e with explicit preimage da. Hence Submodule.span_le puts the top submodule inside range e. LinearMap.range_eq_top yields surjectivity.
Construct LinearEquiv.ofBijective e from injectivity and surjectivity. Its underlying map is e, so the already proved d-formula supplies the required normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_sections_for_chosen_derivation (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
    let D := Classical.choose (exists_diagonalConormalDerivation f)
    ∃ e : CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U.1)]
          Γ(diagonalConormal f, U.1),
        ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), e (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) =
          D.d (X := op U.1) a
